description_en: Disables stream ingest for a specified stream. You can preset a time to resume the stream
description_zh: 禁止某条流的推送，可以预设某个时刻将流恢复
kebab_example: aliyun live forbid-live-stream --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --live-stream-type publisher --region cn-hangzhou
name: ForbidLiveStream

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the ingest stream belongs. You can view the AppName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.help_zh: 推流所属应用名称。您可在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html页面查看AppName
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the ingest stream. You can view the StreamName on the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/197397.html page
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to disable stream ingest or streaming. Currently, only disabling stream ingest is supported: publisher
parameters.help_zh: 用于指定禁止推流或者播流。目前仅支持禁止推流：publisher
parameters.name: live_stream_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only interrupt the stream without adding it to the blacklist. Valid values:

yes: Only interrupts the stream without adding it to the blacklist (supports upstream ingest or upstream streaming).

no: Interrupts the stream and adds it to the blacklist.

Default value: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否只断流不加入黑名单。取值：

yes：只断流不加黑名单（支持上行推送或上行播流）。

no：断流加入黑名单。

不填默认为no
parameters.name: oneshot

parameters.help_en:
The time to resume the stream. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

If the Oneshot parameter is set to no and ResumeTime is not specified, the live stream is disabled for 6 months by default.
If a value is specified, the restriction is lifted at the time specified by ResumeTime and the live stream is resumed
parameters.help_zh:
恢复流的时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

当Oneshot参数为no时，ResumeTime不传值时默认禁止直播流指定时间为6个月。
如果传值则可在ResumeTime指定的时间点解除限制，恢复直播流
parameters.name: resume_time
